citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
During the inspection, APHIS officials observed two dead young lambs in the shelter for the Dall Sheep, domestic sheep
and zebu. The facility representative indicated to inspectors that he was not aware of these dead animals. The lambs'
decomposing condition suggests they had died more than 24 hours before inspectors found them. Inadequate daily
observation does not assure that an animal that is sick or injured is observed and reported to the attending veterinarian in
a timely manner for appropriate care. Ensure that a routine of adequate daily observations is in place so that timely and
accurate information on problems of animal health, behavior, and well-being is conveyed to the attending veterinarian.

citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
The avian environmental enhancement plan does not address each species of exhibit birds that are at the facility. It does
not address the needs of the following exhibited bird species:
-Ringneck pheasants
-Emu
-Rhea
-Ducks
-Geese
-Pigeons
Lack of consideration for each species' environmental needs does not ensure that a species-appropriate plan for their
environmental enhancement will be provided.
The facility must develop, document and follow a plan including all required elements of 3.154 to enhance each species
environment. The plan must be approved by the attending veterinarian.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee and facility representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
Additional Inspectors:
